# #3 TOC + heading anchors — blind QA (verifier)

**Verdict: FAIL** (1 major, 2 minor). Worktree `md-review-cap-reader` (fb3c2af + uncommitted #5/#3). No src/diff read.
Drivers: `.verify/qa/03/qa.mjs`, `qa2.mjs`, `qa3.mjs`, `qa4.mjs`, each run as
`scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node .verify/qa/03/qaN.mjs` (logs `run1..3.log`, results `results*.json`).
Frozen suite for reference: `VERIFY_ITEMS=3 E2E_FILES=items/03-toc-anchors.test.mjs scripts/verify.sh --only e2e` → PASS 23/23.

- AC-03.3 PASS: 6 links, no "Title", ### indented (30px vs 16px), rail top 52 → 52 after 3000px scroll, `<nav aria-label="Table of contents">` 240px.
- AC-03.4 / 03.13 PASS: one `##`, H1-only, `?view=edit`, `?embed=1`, HTML doc: 0 toc-panel/toc-toggle.
- AC-03.5 PASS: gamma active at +20px; bottom → delta; top of page → first entry.
- AC-03.6 PASS: hash `#beta-section`, heading at header+1px, link active.
- AC-03.7 PASS: collapse → reload → rail hidden, toggle shown (`aria-expanded=false`), LS `"1"`; reopen clears LS; content re-centres.
- AC-03.8 PASS (820×1180, 390×844): no rail, focus on active link, Tab/Shift+Tab trapped, background scroll locked, Esc/backdrop/close return focus to `toc-toggle`, link click closes + lands heading under header.
- AC-03.9 PASS: clipboard `<origin>/d/weekly#%C3%BCber-caf%C3%A9`, "Link copied" toast, hash decodes `#über-café`, only `replace` in history log.
- AC-03.10 PASS: fresh context offset 0.8px (1400) / 2.8px (390).
- AC-03.11 PASS: error toast "Couldn't copy…", hash still updated. execCommand fallback copies the right URL; `?view=read&foo=1` and `?edit=<token>` never leak into the link.
- AC-03.12 PASS: triple-click selection "Section One", TOC text clean, title `… · md-review`.
- AC-03.14 PASS: rail 0–240, content 240–1052, comments 1068–1400, no h-scroll (`review-1400.png`).
- AC-03.15 PASS: axe 0 violations; every anchor label "Copy link to section: …".
- **AC-03.16 FAIL (major)**: poll inserts `## Inserted section` + one paragraph above the active gamma heading → `scrollY` moves only +48px whatever the insert size, gamma goes 56 → 145px below the top, and `beta-section` becomes active within 300ms (3/3 runs). Heading-only insert passes (gamma ends at 110px, still inside the 80px band). This is the only reason the frozen test passes. With 3 paragraphs inserted: gamma at 297px, beta active. Repro: `qa4.mjs`.

## Edge cases
- 300 headings PASS: the rail scrolls itself (scrollTop 4085), active entry stays in view, the page doesn't jump, long entries are ellipsised with `title` (`big-300.png`). One 64ms longtask during 40 fast wheel ticks (INFO).
- Headings 10px apart, final short heading, front matter, blockquote/list headings, emoji-only (`section-1`), `...` (`section-2`), inline `<span>` + image (`Hi span logo img end`), `&amp;` PASS.
- Resize 1400↔820 with drawer open/closed PASS: no stuck scroll lock.
- Reduced motion PASS (instant). Without it, smooth scroll lands by 1.2s.
- Back/Forward after TOC clicks PASS. Keyboard Tab→toc-link→Enter PASS. Ctrl+click opens `/d/<slug>#beta-section` in a new tab and leaves the current page alone PASS.
- Hover/focus anchor visibility, 32px hit area, 44px + 0.55 opacity on `(hover: none)` PASS. Print hides the rail and anchors PASS. `scroll-margin-top` 64 ≥ 52+12 PASS.
- Shortcuts overlay (edit view, `?` with focus on `view-toggle-read`): opens, traps, returns focus PASS. Phone comments drawer (390, review doc): traps, Esc → `comments-toggle` PASS.

## Defects
1. **major**: AC-03.16 above. The poll rebuild doesn't keep the reading position, so the active entry flips to the previous section.
2. **minor**: mermaid above the target heading. Clicking a TOC link before the diagrams finish rendering leaves `#after-diagrams` 37,930px below the viewport for good, with no re-align. Clicking after 3s, and loading with the fragment, both PASS. Repro: `qa2.mjs` "mermaid click-immediately", `mermaid.png`.
3. **minor**: the slug doesn't avoid app element ids. A heading `## app` gets `id="app"`, which duplicates the Vue root `<div id="app">`. `## toc-panel` duplicates the rail `<nav id="toc-panel">`. `## toc-drawer` becomes the `aria-controls` target while the drawer is closed. TOC clicks still work, but loading `/d/<doc>#app` leaves the heading at 422px (1400) / 681px (390) instead of under the header. The same happens for a copied "app" link. Repro: `qa3.mjs` "collide", `collide-*.png`.
